mission_types.description: Follow a suspicious vehicle or target 15m-40m behind without triggering their suspicion meter.
Retrieve sensitive data drives or packages under a time limit across city districts.
Infiltrate crowd spaces or alley corners to intercept encrypted audio transmissions.
Sprint down narrow alley corridors to tackle or corner fleeing informants before they escape.
Step into The Porter Pit arena or street corners for 1-on-1 melee combat.

street_01_pink_cadillac.name: The Mysterious Pink Cadillac
street_01_pink_cadillac.objective_text: Follow the Pink Cadillac at a safe distance (15m-40m) without raising suspicion.

street_02_data_drop.name: Syndicate Intel Chip Transfer
street_02_data_drop.objective_text: Deliver the encrypted data-chip to Porter within 90 seconds.

street_03_park_wiretap.name: Preacher Audio Wiretap
street_03_park_wiretap.objective_text: Blend into the concert/rally crowd and intercept 15s of encrypted audio.
